text:
Noah Patel: I booked EurRail to Berlin for the conference but the vendor only sent a card receipt, not a VAT invoice. Need to file expense — can finance chase an invoice or should I get manager approval to reimburse gross? Receipt image attached.

ExpenseBot: Quick note — per policy, VAT reclaim requires a proper invoice showing vendor VAT registration number. Card receipts usually don’t qualify. See https://redwood.internal/expenses/vat-policy :mag_right:

Maya Chen (Finance): We can try to request an invoice from EurRail, but AP will need the transaction id, vendor email, and the exact charge line items. If the vendor cannot issue an invoice with VAT reg#, we can still reimburse the employee but we cannot reclaim VAT. Please submit the expense in Concur and mark "VAT missing" so we can track. :thinking:

Priya Rao: @Noah Patel pls paste the vendor contact + last 4 of the card + total amt here. If AP can’t get an invoice, I can approve the reimbursement (minus VAT reclaim) as an exception for this trip. Also flag the seat upgrade — that's above per-diem.

Noah Patel: Vendor email: invoices@eurrail.eu, transaction id: 0x9a3b7f, last4 card: 1234, total: €312.50 (seat upgrade €45). I submitted the expense draft but left VAT field empty. Can AP chase? Screenshot of receipt uploaded to the Concur draft.

Liam Ortiz: I'll open a vendor chase ticket with AP and include the Concur link. Reference RDW-INV-2026-72. @Maya Chen (Finance) quick question — if vendor sends a "simplified invoice" with VAT reg# and a VAT line, is that sufficient for reclaim?

Maya Chen (Finance): Yes — a simplified invoice that includes the vendor VAT reg number and VAT amount per local regs is generally enough for reclaim. If it's only a merchant receipt with no VAT reg# we cannot reclaim. I'll add notes to the ticket and aim to get a response in 3-5 business days.

Noah Patel: Thanks both — please escalate. I’ll keep the Concur entry updated. :thumbsup:
